name: GRB2 associated binding protein 1

function.text: GAB1 encodes GRB2-associated-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include signaling adaptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

function.text: GAB1 encodes GRB2-associated-binding protein 1. It is an adapter protein that plays a role in intracellular signaling cascades triggered by activated receptor-type kinases. It contributes to FGFR1 signaling. It is probably involved in signaling by the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and the insulin receptor (INSR).
